Insaano! Us Parwardigar se daro jis ne tum sab ko ek nafs se paida kiya hai, aur us ka joda bhi usi ki jins se paida kiya hai, aur phir donon se ba-kasrat mard o aurat duniya mein phaila diye hain. Aur us Khuda se bhi daro jis ke zariye ek doosre se sawaal karte ho, aur qaraabatdaaron ki be-ta'alluqi se bhi. Allah tum sab ke aamaal ka nigraan hai
Aur yateemon ko un ka maal de do, aur un ke maal ko apne maal se na badlo, aur un ke maal ko apne maal ke saath mila kar na kha jaao ke yeh gunaah-e-kabeera hai

Aur agar yateemon ke baare mein insaaf na kar sakne ka khatra hai to jo auratein tumhein pasand hain do, teen, chaar un se nikaah kar lo, aur agar un mein bhi insaaf na kar sakne ka khatra hai to sirf ek, ya jo kaneezein tumhaare haath ki milkiyat hain. Yeh baat insaaf se tajaawuz na karne se qareeb-tar hai
Auraton ko un ka mehr ata kar do, phir agar woh khushi khushi tumhein dena chaahein to shauq se kha lo
Aur naasamajh logon ko un ke woh amwaal jin ko tumhaare liye qiyaam ka zariya banaaya gaya hai na do. Us mein un ke khaane kapde ka intizaam kar do aur un se munaasib guftagoo karo

Aur yateemon ka imtehaan lo, aur jab woh nikaah ke qaabil ho jaayein to agar un mein rasheed hone ka ehsaas karo to un ke amwaal un ke hawaale kar do, aur ziyaadati ke saath ya is khauf se ke kaheen woh bade na ho jaayein jaldi jaldi na kha jaao. Aur tum mein jo ghani hai woh un ke maal se parhez kare, aur jo faqeer hai woh bhi sirf ba-qadr-e-munaasib khaaye. Phir jab un ke amwaal un ke hawaale karo to gawaah bana lo, aur Khuda to hisaab ke liye khud hi kaafi hai

Mardon ke liye un ke waalidain aur aqrabaa ke tarke mein ek hissa hai, aur auraton ke liye bhi un ke waalidain aur aqrabaa ke tarke mein se ek hissa hai, woh maal bahut ho ya thoda, yeh hissa ba-taur-e-fareeza hai
Aur agar taqseem ke waqt deegar qaraabatdaar, aitaam, masaakeen bhi aa jaayein to inhein bhi us mein se ba-taur-e-rizq de do aur un se narm aur munaasib guftagoo karo
Aur un logon ko is baat se darna chaahiye ke agar woh khud apne baad za'eef o naatawaan aulaad chhod jaate to kis qadr pareshaan hote, lihaaza Khuda se darein aur seedhi seedhi guftagoo karein
Jo log zaalimaana andaaz se yateemon ka maal kha jaate hain woh dar-haqeeqat apne pet mein aag bhar rahe hain, aur anqareeb waasil-e-Jahannam honge

Allah tumhaari aulaad ke baare mein tumhein hidaayat farmaata hai: ek ladke ka hissa do ladkiyon ke hisse ke baraabar hai. Pas agar ladkiyaan do se zaaid hon to tarke ka do tihaai un ka haq hai, aur agar sirf ek ladki hai to nisf (tarka) us ka hai. Aur mayyit ki aulaad hone ki soorat mein waalidain mein se har ek ko tarke ka chhatha hissa milega, aur agar mayyit ki aulaad na ho balke sirf maa baap us ke waaris hon to us ki maa ko teesra hissa milega. Pas agar mayyit ke bhaai hon to maa ko chhatha hissa milega. Yeh taqseem mayyit ki wasiyyat par amal karne aur us ke qarz ki adaaegi ke baad hogi. Tumhein nahin maaloom tumhaare waalidain aur tumhaari aulaad mein faaide ke hawaale se kaun tumhaare ziyaada qareeb hai. Yeh hisse Allah ke muqarrar-karda hain, yaqeenan Allah bada jaanne waala, ba-hikmat hai

Aur tumhein apni biwiyon ke tarke mein se, agar un ki aulaad na ho, nisf hissa milega, aur agar un ki aulaad ho to un ke tarke mein se chauthaai tumhaara hoga. Yeh taqseem mayyit ki wasiyyat par amal karne aur qarz ada karne ke baad hogi. Aur tumhaari aulaad na ho to inhein tumhaare tarke mein se chauthaai milega, aur agar tumhaari aulaad ho to inhein tumhaare tarke mein se aathwaan hissa milega. Yeh taqseem tumhaari wasiyyat par amal karne aur qarz ada karne ke baad hogi. Aur agar koi mard ya aurat be-aulaad ho aur waalidain bhi zinda na hon aur us ka ek bhaai ya ek behan ho to bhaai aur behan mein se har ek ko chhatha hissa milega. Pas agar behan bhaai ek se ziyaada hon to sab ek tihaai hisse mein shareek honge. Yeh taqseem wasiyyat par amal karne aur qarz ada karne ke baad hogi, basharte ke zarar-rasaan na ho. Yeh naseehat Allah ki taraf se hai aur Allah bada daana, burdbaar hai

Yeh sab Ilaahi hudood hain, aur jo Allah o Rasool ki itaa'at karega Khuda use un jannaton mein daakhil karega jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi aur woh un mein hamesha rahenge, aur dar-haqeeqat yahi sab se badi kaamyaabi hai
Aur jo Khuda o Rasool ki naafarmaani karega aur us ke hudood se tajaawuz kar jaaega Khuda use Jahannam mein daakhil kar dega aur woh wahin hamesha rahega, aur us ke liye ruswa-kun azaab hai

Aur tumhaari auraton mein se jo auratein badkaari karein un par apnon mein se chaar gawaahon ki gawaahi lo, aur jab gawaahi de dein to inhein gharon mein band kar do yahaan tak ke maut aa jaaye ya Khuda un ke liye koi raasta muqarrar kar de
Aur tum mein se jo aadmi badkaari karein inhein aziyyat do, phir agar tauba kar lein aur apne haal ki islaah kar lein to un se e'raaz karo, ke Khuda bahut tauba qubool karne waala aur meharbaan hai

Tauba Khuda ke zimme sirf un logon ke liye hai jo jahaalat ki bina par buraai karte hain aur phir fauran tauba kar lete hain, ke Khuda un ki tauba ko qubool kar leta hai, woh aleem o daana bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi

Aur tauba un logon ke liye nahin hai jo pehle buraaiyaan karte hain aur phir jab maut saamne aa jaati hai to kehte hain ke ab hum ne tauba kar li, aur na un ke liye hai jo haalat-e-kufr mein mar jaate hain, ke un ke liye hum ne bada dardnaak azaab muhayya kar rakha hai

Ae imaan waalo! Tumhaare liye jaaiz nahin hai ke jabran auraton ke waaris ban jaao, aur khabardaar inhein mana' bhi na karo ke jo kuch un ko de diya hai us ka kuch hissa le lo, magar yeh ke waazeh taur par badkaari karein. Aur un ke saath nek bartaao karo. Ab agar tum inhein naapasand bhi karte ho to ho sakta hai ke tum kisi cheez ko naapasand karte ho aur Khuda usi mein khair-e-kaseer qaraar de de

Aur agar tum ek zauja ki jagah par doosri zauja ko laana chaaho aur ek ko maal-e-kaseer bhi de chuke ho to khabardaar us mein se kuch waapas na lena. Kya tum us maal ko bohtaan aur khule gunaah ke taur par lena chaahte ho
Aur aakhir kis tarah tum maal ko waapas loge jab ke ek doosre se muttasil ho chuka hai, aur un auraton ne tum se bahut sakht qism ka ahd liya hai

Aur khabardaar jin auraton se tumhaare baap daada ne nikaah (jimaa') kiya hai un se nikaah na karna, magar woh jo ab tak ho chuka hai. Yeh khuli hui buraai aur Parwardigar ka ghazab aur badtareen raasta hai

Tumhaare oopar tumhaari maayein, betiyaan, behnein, phuphiyaan, khaalaaein, bhateejiyaan, bhaanjiyaan, woh maayein jinhon ne tum ko doodh pilaaya hai, tumhaari razaa'i (doodh-shareek) behnein, tumhaari biwiyon ki maayein, tumhaari parwarda auratein jo tumhaari aaghosh mein hain aur un auraton ki aulaad jin se tum ne dukhool kiya hai, haan agar dukhool nahin kiya hai to koi harj nahin hai, aur tumhaare farzandon ki biwiyaan jo farzand tumhaare sulb se hain, aur do behnon ka ek saath jama karna, sab haraam kar diya gaya hai ilaawa us ke jo is se pehle ho chuka hai, ke Khuda bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Aur tum par haraam hain shaadi-shuda auratein ilaawa un ke jo tumhaari kaneezein ban jaayein. Yeh Khuda ka khula hua qaanoon hai. Aur un sab auraton ke ilaawa tumhaare liye halaal hai ke apne amwaal ke zariye auraton se rishta paida karo, iffat o paak-daamani ke saath, sifaah o zina ke saath nahin. Pas jo bhi un auraton se tamattu' kare un ki ujrat inhein ba-taur-e-fareeza de de, aur fareeze ke baad aapas mein razaamandi ho jaaye to koi harj nahin hai. Beshak Allah Aleem bhi hai aur Hakeem bhi hai

Aur jis ke paas is qadr maali wus'at nahin hai ke momin aazaad auraton se nikaah kare to woh momina kaneez aurat se aqd kar le. Khuda tumhaare imaan se baakhabar hai, tum sab ek doosre se ho. Un kaneezon se un ke ahl ki ijaazat se aqd karo aur inhein un ki munaasib ujrat (mehr) de do. Un kaneezon se aqd karo jo afeefa aur paak-daaman hon, na ke khullam khulla zina-kaar hon aur na chori chhupe dosti karne waali hon. Phir jab aqd mein aa gayin to agar zina karaayein to un ke liye aazaad auraton ke nisf ke baraabar saza hai. Yeh kaneezon se aqd un ke liye hai jo be-sabri ka khatra rakhte hon, warna sabr karo to tumhaare haq mein behtar hai, aur Allah Ghafoor o Raheem hai

Woh chaahta hai ke tumhaare liye waazeh ahkaam bayaan kar de aur tumhein tum se pehle waalon ke tareeqa-e-kaar ki hidaayat kar de aur tumhaari tauba qubool kar le, aur woh khoob jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Khuda chaahta hai ke tumhaari tauba qubool kare, aur khwaahishaat ki pairavi karne waale chaahte hain ke tumhein bilkul hi raah-e-haq se door kar dein
Khuda chaahta hai ke tumhaare liye takhfeef ka saamaan kar de, aur insaan to kamzor hi paida kiya gaya hai

Ae imaan waalo! Aapas mein ek doosre ke maal ko naahaq tareeqe se na kha jaaya karo, magar yeh ke baahami razaamandi se mu'aamalat ho, aur khabardaar apne nafs ko qatl na karo. Allah tumhaare haal par bahut meharbaan hai
Aur jo aisa iqdaam hudood se tajaawuz aur zulm ke unwaan se karega hum anqareeb use Jahannam mein daal denge, aur Allah ke liye yeh kaam bahut aasaan hai
Agar tum bade bade gunaahon se jin se tumhein roka gaya hai parhez kar loge to hum doosre gunaahon ki parda-poshi kar denge aur tumhein ba-izzat manzil tak pahuncha denge

Aur khabardaar jo Khuda ne ba'z afraad ko ba'z se kuch ziyaada diya hai us ki tamanna aur aarzoo na karna. Mardon ke liye woh hissa hai jo unhon ne kamaaya hai aur auraton ke liye woh hissa hai jo unhon ne haasil kiya hai. Allah se us ke fazl ka sawaal karo ke woh beshak har shai ka jaanne waala hai

Aur jo kuch maa baap ya aqrabaa ne chhoda hai hum ne sab ke liye waali o waaris muqarrar kar diye hain, aur jin se tum ne ahd o paimaan kiya hai un ka hissa bhi inhein de do. Beshak Allah har shai par gawaah aur nigraan hai

Mard auraton ke haakim aur nigraan hain un fazeelaton ki bina par jo Khuda ne ba'z ko ba'z par di hain, aur is bina par ke unhon ne auraton par apna maal kharch kiya hai. Pas nek auratein wahi hain jo shauharon ki itaa'at karne waali aur un ki ghaibat mein un cheezon ki hifaazat karne waali hain jin ki Khuda ne hifaazat chaahi hai. Aur jin auraton ki naafarmaani ka khatra hai inhein mau'iza karo, inhein khwaabgaah mein alag kar do aur maaro, aur phir itaa'at karne lagein to koi ziyaadati ki raah talaash na karo, ke Khuda bahut buland aur buzurg hai

Aur agar donon ke darmiyaan ikhtilaaf ka andesha hai to ek hakam mard ki taraf se aur ek aurat waalon mein se bhejo. Phir woh donon islaah chaahenge to Khuda un ke darmiyaan ham-aahangi paida kar dega. Beshak Allah Aleem bhi hai aur Khabeer bhi

Aur Allah ki ibaadat karo aur kisi shai ko us ka shareek na banaao, aur waalidain ke saath nek bartaao karo, aur qaraabatdaaron ke saath, aur yateemon, miskeenon, qareeb ke hamsaaye, door ke hamsaaye, pehlu-nasheen, musaafir-e-ghurbat-zada, ghulaam o kaneez sab ke saath nek bartaao karo, ke Allah maghroor aur mutakabbir logon ko pasand nahin karta

Jo khud bhi bukhl karte hain aur doosron ko bhi bukhl ka hukm dete hain, aur jo kuch Khuda ne apne fazl o karam se ata kiya hai us par parda daalte hain, aur hum ne kaafiron ke waaste ruswa-kun azaab muhayya kar rakha hai

Aur jo log apne amwaal ko logon ko dikhaane ke liye kharch karte hain aur Allah aur aakhirat par imaan nahin rakhte hain, inhein maaloom hona chaahiye ke jis ka Shaitaan saathi ho jaaye woh badtareen saathi hai
Un ka kya nuqsaan hai agar yeh Allah aur aakhirat par imaan le aayein aur jo Allah ne ba-taur-e-rizq diya hai use us ki raah mein kharch karein, aur Allah har ek ko khoob jaanta hai
Allah kisi par zarra baraabar zulm nahin karta. Insaan ke paas neki hoti hai to use dugna kar deta hai aur apne paas se ajr-e-azeem ata karta hai
Us waqt kya hoga jab hum har ummat ko us ke gawaah ke saath bulaayenge, aur Paighambar! Aap ko un sab ka gawaah bana kar bulaayenge

Us din jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya hai aur Rasool ki naafarmaani ki hai yeh khwaahish karenge ke ae kaash un ke oopar se zameen baraabar kar di jaati, aur woh Khuda se kisi baat ko nahin chhupa sakte hain

Imaan waalo! Khabardaar nashe ki haalat mein namaaz ke qareeb bhi na jaana jab tak yeh hosh na aa jaaye ke tum kya keh rahe ho, aur janaabat ki haalat mein bhi, magar yeh ke raaste se guzar rahe ho, jab tak ghusl na kar lo. Aur agar beemaar ho ya safar ki haalat mein ho, aur kisi ke paikhaana nikal aaye ya auraton se baahami jinsi rabt qaaim ho jaaye, aur paani na mile to paak mitti se tayammum kar lo, is tarah ke apne chehron aur haathon par masah kar lo. Beshak Khuda bahut maaf karne waala aur bakhshne waala hai
Kya tum ne un logon ko nahin dekha hai jinhein kitaab ka thoda sa hissa de diya gaya hai ke woh gumraahi ka sauda karte hain aur chaahte hain ke tum bhi raaste se behak jaao
Aur Allah tumhaare dushmanon ko khoob jaanta hai, aur woh tumhaari sarparasti aur madad ke liye kaafi hai

Yahoodiyon mein woh log bhi hain jo kalimaat-e-Ilaahiya ko un ki jagah se hata dete hain, aur kehte hain ke hum ne baat suni aur naafarmaani ki, aur tum bhi suno magar tumhaari baat na suni jaaegi. Yeh sab zabaan ke tod marod aur deen mein ta'na-zani ki bina par hota hai. Haalaanke agar yeh log yeh kehte ke hum ne suna aur itaa'at ki, aap bhi suniye aur nazar-e-karam kijiye, to un ke haq mein behtar aur munaasib tha, lekin Khuda ne un ke kufr ki bina par un par la'nat ki hai, to yeh imaan na laayenge magar bahut qaleel ta'daad mein

Ae woh logo jinhein kitaab di gayi hai! Hamaare naazil kiye hue Quran par imaan le aao jo tumhaari kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne waala hai, qabl is ke ke hum tumhaare chehron ko bigaad kar pusht ki taraf pher dein ya un par is tarah la'nat karein jis tarah hum ne ashaab-e-sabt par la'nat ki hai, aur Allah ka hukm bahar-haal naafiz hai
Allah is baat ko maaf nahin kar sakta ke us ka shareek qaraar diya jaaye, aur us ke ilaawa jis ko chaahe bakhsh sakta hai, aur jo bhi us ka shareek banaaega us ne bahut bada gunaah kiya hai
Kya tum ne un logon ko nahin dekha jo apne nafs ki paakeezgi ka izhaar karte hain, haalaanke Allah jis ko chaahta hai paakeeza banaata hai, aur bandon par dhaage ke baraabar bhi zulm nahin hota
Dekho to unhon ne kis tarah Khuda par khullam khulla ilzaam lagaaya hai, aur yahi un ke khullam khulla gunaah ke liye kaafi hai

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke jin logon ko kitaab ka kuch hissa de diya gaya woh Shaitaan aur buton par imaan rakhte hain, aur kuffaar ko bhi bataate hain ke yeh log imaan waalon se ziyaada seedhe raaste par hain
Yahi woh log hain jin par Khuda ne la'nat ki hai, aur jis par Khuda la'nat kar de aap phir us ka koi madadgaar na paayenge
Kya mulk-e-duniya mein un ka bhi koi hissa hai ke logon ko bhoosi baraabar bhi nahin dena chaahte hain
Ya woh un logon se hasad karte hain jinhein Khuda ne apne fazl o karam se bahut kuch ata kiya hai? To phir hum ne Aal-e-Ibraheem ko kitaab o hikmat aur mulk-e-azeem sab kuch ata kiya hai
Phir un mein se ba'z un cheezon par imaan le aaye aur ba'z ne inkaar kar diya, aur un logon ke liye dehakta hua Jahannam hi kaafi hai

Beshak jin logon ne hamaari aayaton ka inkaar kiya hai hum inhein aag mein bhoon denge, aur jab ek khaal pak jaaegi to doosri badal denge taake azaab ka maza chakhte rahein. Khuda sab par ghaalib aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Aur jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hum anqareeb inhein jannaton mein daakhil karenge jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi aur woh unhi mein hamesha rahenge. Un ke liye wahaan paakeeza biwiyaan hongi aur inhein ghani chhaaon mein rakha jaaega

Beshak Allah tumhein hukm deta hai ke amaanaton ko un ke ahl tak pahuncha do, aur jab koi faisla karo to insaaf ke saath karo. Allah tumhein behtareen naseehat karta hai, beshak Allah Samee' bhi hai aur Baseer bhi

Imaan waalo! Allah ki itaa'at karo, Rasool aur saahibaan-e-amr ki itaa'at karo jo tum hi mein se hain. Phir agar aapas mein kisi baat mein ikhtilaaf ho jaaye to use Khuda aur Rasool ki taraf palta do agar tum Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat par imaan rakhne waale ho. Yahi tumhaare haq mein khair aur anjaam ke e'tebaar se behtareen baat hai

Kya aap ne un logon ko nahin dekha jin ka khayaal yeh hai ke woh aap par aur aap se pehle naazil hone waali cheezon par imaan le aaye hain, aur phir yeh chaahte hain ke sarkash logon ke paas faisla karaayein, jab ke inhein hukm diya gaya hai ke Taaghoot ka inkaar karein, aur Shaitaan to yahi chaahta hai ke inhein gumraahi mein door tak kheench kar le jaaye
Aur jab un se kaha jaata hai ke hukm-e-Khuda aur us ke Rasool ki taraf aao to tum munaafiqeen ko dekhoge ke woh shiddat se inkaar kar dete hain
Pas us waqt kya hoga jab un par un ke aamaal ki bina par museebat naazil hogi, aur woh aap ke paas aa kar Khuda ki qasam khaayenge ke hamaara maqsad sirf neki karna aur ittihaad paida karna tha
Yahi woh log hain jin ke dil ka haal Khuda khoob jaanta hai, lihaaza aap un se kinaara-kash rahein, inhein naseehat karein aur un ke dil par asar karne waali mahal-e-mauqa ke mutaabiq baat karein

Aur hum ne kisi rasool ko bhi nahin bheja hai magar sirf is liye ke hukm-e-Khuda se us ki itaa'at ki jaaye. Aur kaash jab un logon ne apne nafs par zulm kiya tha to aap ke paas aate aur khud bhi apne gunaahon ke liye istighfaar karte aur Rasool bhi un ke haq mein istighfaar karta, to yeh Khuda ko bada hi tauba qubool karne waala aur meharbaan paate

Pas aap ke Parwardigar ki qasam ke yeh hargiz saahib-e-imaan na ban sakenge jab tak aap ko apne ikhtilaafaat mein hakam na banaayein, aur phir jab aap faisla kar dein to apne dil mein kisi tarah ki tangi ka ehsaas na karein aur aap ke faisle ke saamne saraapa tasleem ho jaayein

Aur agar hum in munaafiqeen par farz kar dete ke apne ko qatl kar daalein ya ghar chhod kar nikal jaayein to chand afraad ke ilaawa koi amal na karta, haalaanke agar yeh is naseehat par amal karte to un ke haq mein behtar hi hota aur un ko ziyaada sabaat haasil hota
Aur hum inhein apni taraf se ajr-e-azeem bhi ata karte
Aur inhein seedhe raaste ki hidaayat bhi kar dete
Aur jo bhi Allah aur Rasool ki itaa'at karega woh un logon ke saath rahega jin par Khuda ne ne'matein naazil ki hain: ambiya, siddeeqeen, shuhada aur saaliheen, aur yahi behtareen rufaqaa hain
Yeh Allah ki taraf se fazl o karam hai, aur Khuda har ek ke haalaat ke ilm ke liye kaafi hai
Imaan waalo! Apne tahaffuz ka saamaan sambhaal lo aur jamaa'at jamaa'at ya ikattha, jaisa mauqa ho, sab nikal pado
Tum mein aise log bhi ghus gaye hain jo logon ko rokenge, aur agar tum par koi museebat aa gayi to kahenge ke Khuda ne hum par ehsaan kiya ke hum un ke saath haazir nahin the

Aur agar tumhein Khudaai fazl o karam mil gaya to is tarah jaise tumhaare un ke darmiyaan kabhi dosti hi nahin thi, kehne lagenge ke kaash hum bhi un ke saath hote aur kaamyaabi ki azeem manzil par faaiz ho jaate

Ab zaroorat hai ke raah-e-Khuda mein woh log jihaad karein jo zindagaani-e-duniya ko aakhirat ke ewaz bech daalte hain, aur jo bhi raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad karega, woh qatl ho jaaye ya ghaalib aa jaaye, donon sooraton mein hum use ajr-e-azeem ata karenge

Aur aakhir tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke tum Allah ki raah mein aur un kamzor mardon, auraton aur bachchon ke liye jihaad nahin karte ho jinhein kamzor bana kar rakha gaya hai, aur jo baraabar dua karte hain ke Khudaya! Humein is qarye se najaat de de jis ke baashinde zaalim hain, aur hamaare liye koi sarparast aur apni taraf se madadgaar qaraar de de

Imaan waale hamesha Allah ki raah mein jihaad karte hain aur jo kaafir hain woh hamesha Taaghoot ki raah mein ladte hain, lihaaza tum Shaitaan ke saathiyon se jihaad karo, beshak Shaitaan ka makr bahut kamzor hota hai

Kya tum ne un logon ko nahin dekha jin se kaha gaya tha ke haath roke rakho aur namaaz qaaim karo, zakaat ada karo (to bechain ho gaye), aur jab jihaad waajib kar diya gaya to ek giroh logon (dushmanon) se is qadr darta tha jaise Khuda se darta ho ya us se bhi kuch ziyaada, aur yeh kehte hain ke Khudaya! Itni jaldi kyon jihaad waajib kar diya, kaash thodi muddat tak aur taal diya jaata. Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke duniya ka sarmaaya bahut thoda hai aur aakhirat saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye behtareen jagah hai, aur tum par dhaaga baraabar bhi zulm nahin kiya jaaega

Tum jahaan bhi rahoge maut tumhein pa legi chaahe mustahkam qil'on mein kyon na band ho jaao. Un logon ka haal yeh hai ke achchhe haalaat paida hote hain to kehte hain ke yeh Khuda ki taraf se hai, aur museebat aati hai to kehte hain ke yeh aap ki taraf se hai. To aap keh dijiye ke sab Khuda ki taraf se hai. Phir aakhir is qaum ko kya ho gaya hai ke yeh koi baat samajhti hi nahin hai

Tum tak jo bhi achchhaai aur kaamyaabi pahunchi hai woh Allah ki taraf se hai, aur jo bhi buraai pahunchi hai woh khud tumhaari taraf se hai. Aur ae Paighambar! Hum ne aap ko logon ke liye rasool banaaya hai aur Khuda gawaahi ke liye kaafi hai
Jo Rasool ki itaa'at karega us ne Allah ki itaa'at ki, aur jo munh mod lega to hum ne aap ko us ka zimmedaar bana kar nahin bheja hai

Aur yeh log pehle itaa'at ki baat karte hain, phir jab aap ke paas se baahar nikalte hain to ek giroh apne qaul ke khilaaf tadbeerein karta hai, aur Khuda un ki un baaton ko likh raha hai. Aap un se e'raaz karein aur Khuda par bharosa karein, aur Khuda is zimmedaari ke liye kaafi hai
Kya yeh log Quran mein ghaur o fikr nahin karte hain, ke agar woh ghair-e-Khuda ki taraf se hota to us mein bada ikhtilaaf hota

Aur jab un ke paas amn ya khauf ki khabar aati hai to fauran nashr kar dete hain, haalaanke agar Rasool aur saahibaan-e-amr ki taraf palta dete to un se istifaada karne waale haqeeqat-e-haal ka ilm paida kar lete. Aur agar tum logon par Khuda ka fazl aur us ki rehmat na hoti to chand afraad ke ilaawa sab Shaitaan ka ittibaa' kar lete

Ab aap raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad karein, aur aap apne nafs ke ilaawa doosron ke mukallaf nahin hain, aur momineen ko jihaad par aamaada karein. Anqareeb Khuda kuffaar ke shar ko rok dega, aur Allah intihaai taaqat waala aur sakht saza dene waala hai
Jo shakhs achchhi sifaarish karega use us ka hissa milega, aur jo buri sifaarish karega use us mein se hissa milega, aur Allah har shai par iqtidaar rakhne waala hai
Aur jab tum logon ko koi tohfa (salaam) pesh kiya jaaye to us se behtar ya kam se kam waisa hi waapas karo, ke beshak Allah har shai ka hisaab karne waala hai
Allah woh Khuda hai jis ke ilaawa koi ma'bood nahin hai. Woh tum sab ko roz-e-qiyaamat jama karega aur is mein koi shak nahin hai, aur Allah se ziyaada sachchi baat kaun karne waala hai

Aakhir tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke munaafiqeen ke baare mein do giroh ho gaye ho, jab ke Allah ne un ke aamaal ki bina par inhein ulat diya hai? Kya tum use hidaayat dena chaahte ho jise Khuda ne gumraahi par chhod diya hai? Haalaanke jise Khuda gumraahi mein chhod de us ke liye tum koi raasta nahin nikaal sakte

Yeh munaafiqeen chaahte hain ke tum bhi un ki tarah kaafir ho jaao aur sab baraabar ho jaayein. To khabardaar tum inhein apna dost na banaana jab tak raah-e-Khuda mein hijrat na karein. Phir yeh inhiraaf karein to inhein giraftaar kar lo aur jahaan pa jaao qatl kar do, aur khabardaar un mein se kisi ko apna dost aur madadgaar na banaana

Ilaawa un ke jo kisi aisi qaum se mil jaayein jin ke aur tumhaare darmiyaan mu'aahida ho, ya woh tumhaare paas dil-tang ho kar aa jaayein ke na tum se jang karenge aur na apni qaum se. Aur agar Khuda chaahta to un ko tumhaare oopar musallat kar deta aur woh tum se bhi jang karte. Lihaaza agar tum se alag rahein aur jang na karein aur sulh ka paighaam dein to Khuda ne tumhaare liye un ke oopar koi raah nahin qaraar di hai

Anqareeb tum ek aur jamaa'at ko paaoge jo chaahte hain ke tum se bhi mahfooz rahein aur apni qaum se bhi. Yeh jab bhi fitne ki taraf bulaaye jaate hain ulte us mein aundhe munh gir padte hain. Lihaaza yeh agar tum se alag na hon aur sulh ka paighaam na dein aur haath na rokein to inhein giraftaar kar lo aur jahaan paao qatl kar do. Yahi woh hain ke jin par tumhein khula ghalaba ata kiya gaya hai

Aur kisi momin ko yeh haq nahin hai ke woh kisi momin ko qatl kar de magar ghalati se, aur jo ghalati se qatl kar de use chaahiye ke ek ghulaam aazaad kare aur maqtool ke waarison ko diyat de, magar yeh ke woh maaf kar dein. Phir agar maqtool aisi qaum se hai jo tumhaari dushman hai aur (ittifaaq se) khud momin hai to sirf ghulaam aazaad karna hoga, aur agar aisi qaum ka fard hai jis ka tum se mu'aahida hai to us ke ahl ko diyat dena padegi aur ek momin ghulaam aazaad karna hoga, aur ghulaam na mile to do maah ke musalsal roze rakhna honge. Yahi Allah ki taraf se tauba ka raasta hai, aur Allah sab ki niyyaton se baakhabar hai aur apne ahkaam mein saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai

Aur jo bhi kisi momin ko qasdan qatl kar dega us ki jaza Jahannam hai, usi mein hamesha rehna hai, aur us par Khuda ka ghazab bhi hai aur Khuda la'nat bhi karta hai, aur us ne us ke liye azaab-e-azeem bhi muhayya kar rakha hai

Imaan waalo! Jab tum raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad ke liye safar karo to pehle tahqeeq kar lo, aur khabardaar jo Islam ki pesh-kash kare us se yeh na kehna ke tu momin nahin hai, ke is tarah tum zindagaani-e-duniya ka chand-roza sarmaaya chaahte ho, aur Khuda ke paas ba-kasrat fawaaid paaye jaate hain. Aakhir tum bhi to pehle aise hi kaafir the, Khuda ne tum par ehsaan kiya ke tumhaare Islam ko qubool kar liya (aur dil cheerne ki shart nahin lagaayi). To ab tum bhi iqdaam se pehle tahqeeq karo ke Khuda tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Andhe, beemaar aur ma'zoor afraad ke ilaawa ghar baith rehne waale saahibaan-e-imaan hargiz un logon ke baraabar nahin ho sakte jo raah-e-Khuda mein apne jaan o maal se jihaad karne waale hain. Allah ne apne maal aur jaan se jihaad karne waalon ko baith rehne waalon par imtiyaaz inaayat kiye hain, aur har ek se neki ka wa'da kiya hai, aur mujaahideen ko baith rehne waalon ke muqaable mein ajr-e-azeem ata kiya hai
Us ki taraf se darajaat, maghfirat aur rehmat hai, aur woh bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Jin logon ko malaaika ne is haal mein uthaaya ke woh apne nafs par zulm karne waale the un se poochha ke tum kis haal mein the? Unhon ne kaha ke hum zameen mein kamzor bana diye gaye the. Malaaika ne kaha ke kya zameen-e-Khuda wasee' nahin thi ke tum hijrat kar jaate? Un logon ka thikaana Jahannam hai aur woh badtareen manzil hai
Ilaawa un kamzor mardon, auraton aur bachchon ke jin ke ikhtiyaar mein koi tadbeer na thi aur woh koi raasta na nikaal sakte the
Yahi woh log hain jin ko anqareeb Khuda maaf kar dega ke woh bada maaf karne waala aur bakhshne waala hai

Aur jo bhi raah-e-Khuda mein hijrat karega woh zameen mein bahut se thikaane aur wus'at paaega, aur jo apne ghar se Khuda o Rasool ki taraf hijrat ke iraade se niklega, us ke baad use maut bhi aa jaaegi to us ka ajr Allah ke zimme hai, aur Allah bada bakhshne waala meharbaan hai

Aur jab tum zameen mein safar karo to tumhaare liye koi harj nahin hai ke apni namaazein qasr kar do, agar tumhein kuffaar ke hamla kar dene ka khauf hai, ke kuffaar tumhaare liye khule hue dushman hain

Aur jab aap mujaahideen ke darmiyaan hon aur un ke liye namaaz qaaim karein to un ki ek jamaa'at aap ke saath namaaz padhe aur apne aslaha saath rakhe. Us ke baad jab yeh sajda kar chukein to yeh pusht-panaah ban jaayein aur doosri jamaa'at jis ne namaaz nahin padhi hai woh aa kar shareek-e-namaaz ho jaaye aur apne aslaha aur bachaao ke saamaan apne saath rakhe. Kuffaar ki khwaahish yahi hai ke tum apne saaz o saamaan aur aslahe se ghaafil ho jaao to yeh yakbaargi hamla kar dein. Haan agar baarish ya beemaari ki wajah se aslaha na utha sakte ho to koi harj nahin hai ke aslaha rakh do, lekin bachaao ka saamaan saath rakho. Allah ne kufr karne waalon ke liye ruswa-kun azaab muhayya kar rakha hai

Us ke baad jab yeh namaaz tamaam ho jaaye to khade, baithe, lete hamesha Khuda ko yaad karte raho, aur jab itminaan haasil ho jaaye to baa-qaa'ida namaaz qaaim karo, ke namaaz saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye ek waqt-e-mu'ayyan ke saath fareeza hai

Aur khabardaar dushmanon ka peechha karne mein susti se kaam na lena, ke agar tumhein koi bhi ranj pahunchta hai to tumhaari tarah kuffaar ko bhi takleef pahunchti hai, aur tum Allah se woh ummeedein rakhte ho jo inhein haasil nahin hain, aur Allah har ek ki niyyat ka jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Hum ne aap ki taraf yeh barhaq kitaab naazil ki hai ke logon ke darmiyaan hukm-e-Khuda ke mutaabiq faisla karein aur khiyaanat-kaaron ke taraf-daar na banein
Aur Allah se istighfaar kijiye ke Allah bada Ghafoor o Raheem hai
Aur khabardaar jo log khud apne nafs se khiyaanat karte hain un ki taraf se difaa' na kijiyega, ke Khuda khiyaanat-kaar mujrimon ko hargiz dost nahin rakhta hai

Yeh log insaanon ki nazron se apne ko chhupaate hain aur Khuda se nahin chhup sakte hain, jab ke woh us waqt bhi un ke saath rehta hai jab woh naapasandeeda baaton ki saazish karte hain, aur Khuda un ke tamaam aamaal ka ihaata kiye hue hai

Hoshiyaar! Is waqt tum ne zindagaani-e-duniya mein un ki taraf se jhagda shuroo bhi kar diya to ab roz-e-qiyaamat un ki taraf se Allah se kaun jhagda karega aur kaun un ka wakeel aur taraf-daar banega
Aur jo bhi kisi ke saath buraai karega ya apne nafs par zulm karega, us ke baad istighfaar karega to Khuda ko Ghafoor aur Raheem paaega
Aur jo qasdan gunaah karta hai woh apne hi khilaaf karta hai, aur Khuda sab ka jaanne waala hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai
Aur jo shakhs bhi koi ghalati ya gunaah kar ke doosre be-gunaah ke sar daal deta hai woh bahut bade bohtaan aur khule gunaah ka zimmedaar hota hai

Agar aap par fazl-e-Khuda aur rehmat-e-Parwardigar ka saaya na hota to un ki ek jamaa'at ne aap ko behkaane ka iraada kar liya tha, aur yeh apne ilaawa kisi ko gumraah nahin kar sakte aur aap ko koi takleef nahin pahuncha sakte. Aur Allah ne aap par kitaab aur hikmat naazil ki hai, aur aap ko un tamaam baaton ka ilm de diya hai jin ka ilm na tha, aur aap par Khuda ka bahut bada fazl hai

Un logon ki aksar raaz ki baaton mein koi khair nahin hai, magar woh shakhs jo kisi sadqe, kaar-e-khair ya logon ke darmiyaan islaah ka hukm de, aur jo bhi yeh saare kaam razaa-e-Ilaahi ki talab mein anjaam dega hum use ajr-e-azeem ata karenge

Aur jo shakhs bhi hidaayat ke waazeh ho jaane ke baad Rasool se ikhtilaaf karega aur momineen ke raaste ke ilaawa koi doosra raasta ikhtiyaar karega, use hum idhar hi pher denge jidhar woh phir gaya hai aur Jahannam mein jhonk denge jo badtareen thikaana hai

Khuda is baat ko maaf nahin kar sakta ke us ka shareek qaraar diya jaaye, aur us ke ilaawa jis ko chaahe bakhsh sakta hai, aur jo Khuda ka shareek qaraar dega woh gumraahi mein bahut door tak chala gaya hai
Yeh log Khuda ko chhod kar bas auraton ki parastish karte hain aur sarkash Shaitaan ko aawaaz dete hain
Jis par Khuda ki la'nat hai, aur us ne Khuda se bhi keh diya ke main tere bandon mein se ek muqarrar hissa zaroor le loonga

Aur inhein gumraah karoonga, ummeedein dilaaoonga, aur aise ahkaam doonga ke woh jaanwaron ke kaan kaat daalenge, phir hukm doonga to Allah ki muqarrara khilqat ko tabdeel kar denge. Aur jo Khuda ko chhod kar Shaitaan ko apna waali aur sarparast banaaega woh khule hue khasaare mein rahega
Shaitaan un se wa'da karta hai aur inhein ummeedein dilaata hai, aur woh jo bhi wa'da karta hai woh dhoke ke siwa kuch nahin hai
Yahi woh log hain jin ka anjaam Jahannam hai aur woh us se chhutkaara nahin pa sakte hain

Aur jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye hum anqareeb inhein un jannaton mein daakhil karenge jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi, woh un mein hamesha hamesha rahenge. Yeh Khuda ka barhaq wa'da hai, aur Khuda se ziyaada raast-go kaun ho sakta hai

Koi kaam na tumhaari ummeedon se banega na ahl-e-kitaab ki ummeedon se. Jo bhi bura kaam karega us ki saza bahar-haal milegi, aur Khuda ke ilaawa use koi sarparast aur madadgaar bhi nahin mil sakta hai
Aur jo bhi nek kaam karega chaahe woh mard ho ya aurat, basharte ke woh saahib-e-imaan bhi ho, un sab ko jannat mein daakhil kiya jaaega aur un par zarra baraabar zulm nahin kiya jaaega

Aur us se achchha deendaar kaun ho sakta hai jo apna rukh Khuda ki taraf rakhe aur nek-kirdaar bhi ho, aur millat-e-Ibraheem ka ittibaa' kare jo baatil se kataraane waale the, aur Allah ne Ibraheem ko apna khaleel aur dost banaaya hai
Aur Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki kul kaainaat hai, aur Allah har shai par ihaata rakhne waala hai

Paighambar! Yeh log aap se yateem ladkiyon ke baare mein hukm-e-Khuda daryaaft karte hain, to aap keh dijiye ke un ke baare mein Khuda ijaazat deta hai, aur jo kitaab mein tumhaare saamne hukm bayaan kiya jaata hai woh un yateem auraton ke baare mein hai jin ko tum un ka haq-e-meeraas nahin dete ho aur chaahte ho ke un se nikaah kar ke saara maal rok lo, aur un kamzor bachchon ke baare mein hai, ke yateemon ke baare mein insaaf ke saath qiyaam karo, aur jo bhi tum kaar-e-khair karoge Khuda us ka ba-khoobi jaanne waala hai

Aur agar koi aurat shauhar se huqooq ada na karne ya us ki kinaara-kashi se talaaq ka khatra mehsoos kare to donon ke liye koi harj nahin hai ke kisi tarah aapas mein sulh kar lein, ke sulh mein behtari hai, aur bukhl to har nafs ke saath haazir rehta hai. Aur agar tum achchha bartaao karoge aur ziyaadati se bachoge to Khuda tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Aur tum kitna hi kyon na chaaho auraton ke darmiyaan mukammal insaaf nahin kar sakte ho, lekin ab bilkul ek taraf na jhuk jaao ke doosri ko mu'allaq chhod do, aur agar islaah kar lo aur taqwa ikhtiyaar karo to Allah bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Aur agar donon alag hi hona chaahein to Khuda donon ko apne khazaane ki wus'at se ghani aur be-niyaaz bana dega, ke Allah saahib-e-wus'at bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai

Aur Allah ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki kul kaainaat hai, aur hum ne tum se pehle ahl-e-kitaab ko aur ab tum ko yeh wasiyyat ki hai ke Allah se daro. Aur agar kufr ikhtiyaar karoge to Khuda ka koi nuqsaan nahin hai, us ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki kul kaainaat hai, aur woh be-niyaaz bhi hai aur qaabil-e-hamd o sataaish bhi hai
Aur Allah ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki kul milkiyat hai, aur woh sab ki nigraani aur kafaalat ke liye kaafi hai
Woh chaahe to tum sab ko utha le jaaye aur doosre logon ko le aaye, aur woh har shai par qaadir hai
Jo insaan duniya ka sawaab aur badla chaahta hai (use maaloom hona chaahiye) ke Khuda ke paas duniya aur aakhirat donon ka in'aam hai, aur woh har ek ka sunne waala aur dekhne waala hai

Ae imaan waalo! Adl o insaaf ke saath qiyaam karo aur Allah ke liye gawaah bano, chaahe apni zaat ya apne waalidain aur aqrabaa hi ke khilaaf kyon na ho. Jis ke liye gawaahi dena hai woh ghani ho ya faqeer, Allah donon ke liye tum se aula hai. Lihaaza khabardaar khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' na karna taake insaaf kar sako, aur agar tod marod se kaam liya ya bilkul kinaara-kashi kar li to yaad rakho ke Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Imaan waalo! Allah, Rasool aur woh kitaab jo Rasool par naazil hui hai aur woh kitaab jo us se pehle naazil ho chuki hai sab par imaan le aao, aur yaad rakho ke jo Khuda, malaaika, kutub-e-samaawiya, rasool aur roz-e-qiyaamat ka inkaar karega woh yaqeenan gumraahi mein bahut door nikal gaya hai

Jo log imaan laaye aur phir kufr ikhtiyaar kar liya, phir imaan le aaye aur phir kaafir ho gaye, aur phir kufr mein shadeed o mazeed ho gaye, to Khuda hargiz inhein maaf nahin kar sakta aur na seedhe raaste ki hidaayat de sakta hai
Aap un munaafiqeen ko dardnaak azaab ki bashaarat de dein
Jo log momineen ko chhod kar kuffaar ko apna waali aur sarparast banaate hain, kya yeh un ke paas izzat talaash kar rahe hain, jab ke saari izzat sirf Allah ke liye hai

Aur us ne kitaab mein yeh baat naazil kar di hai ke jab aayaat-e-Ilaahi ke baare mein yeh suno ke un ka inkaar aur istehzaa ho raha hai to khabardaar un ke saath hargiz na baithna jab tak woh doosri baaton mein masroof na ho jaayein, warna tum unhi ke misl ho jaaoge. Khuda kuffaar aur munaafiqeen sab ko Jahannam mein ek saath ikattha karne waala hai

Yeh munaafiqeen tumhaare haalaat ka intizaar karte rehte hain, ke tumhein Khuda ki taraf se fatah naseeb ho to kahenge kya hum tumhaare saath nahin the? Aur agar kuffaar ko koi hissa mil jaaega to un se kahenge ke kya hum tum par ghaalib nahin aa gaye the aur tumhein momineen se bacha nahin liya tha? To ab Khuda hi qiyaamat ke din tumhaare darmiyaan faisla karega, aur Khuda kuffaar ke liye saahibaan-e-imaan ke khilaaf koi raah nahin de sakta

Munaafiqeen Khuda ko dhoka dena chaahte hain aur Khuda un ko dhoke mein rakhne waala hai, aur yeh namaaz ke liye uthte bhi hain to susti ke saath, logon ko dikhaane ke liye amal karte hain aur Allah ko bahut kam yaad karte hain
Yeh kufr o Islam ke darmiyaan hairaan o sargardaan hain, na in ki taraf hain aur na un ki taraf, aur jis ko Khuda gumraahi mein chhod de us ke liye aap ko koi raasta na milega
Imaan waalo! Khabardaar momineen ko chhod kar kuffaar ko apna waali aur sarparast na banaana. Kya tum chaahte ho ke Allah ke liye apne khilaaf sareehi daleel o hujjat qaraar de lo
Beshak munaafiqeen Jahannam ke sab se nichle tabqe mein honge aur aap un ke liye koi madadgaar na paayenge

Ilaawa un logon ke jo tauba kar lein aur apni islaah kar lein aur Khuda se waabasta ho jaayein aur deen ko khaalis Allah ke liye ikhtiyaar karein, to yeh saahibaan-e-imaan ke saath honge, aur anqareeb Allah un saahibaan-e-imaan ko ajr-e-azeem ata karega
Khuda tum par azaab kar ke kya karega agar tum us ke shukr-guzaar aur saahib-e-imaan ban jaao, aur woh to har ek ke shukriye ka qubool karne waala aur har ek ki niyyat ka jaanne waala hai
Allah mazloom ke ilaawa kisi ki taraf se bhi ala-l-e'laan bura kehne ko pasand nahin karta, aur Allah har baat ka sunne waala aur tamaam haalaat ka jaanne waala hai
Tum kisi khair ka izhaar karo ya use makhfi rakho ya kisi buraai se darguzar karo, to Allah gunaahon ka maaf karne waala aur saahib-e-ikhtiyaar hai

Beshak jo log Allah aur Rasool ka inkaar karte hain aur Khuda aur Rasool ke darmiyaan tafriqa paida karna chaahte hain, aur yeh kehte hain ke hum ba'z par imaan laayenge aur ba'z ka inkaar karenge, aur chaahte hain ke imaan o kufr ke darmiyaan se koi naya raasta nikaal lein
To dar-haqeeqat yahi log kaafir hain, aur hum ne kaafiron ke liye bada ruswa-kun azaab muhayya kar rakha hai

Aur jo log Allah aur Rasool par imaan le aaye aur rasoolon ke darmiyaan tafriqa nahin paida kiya, Khuda anqareeb inhein un ka ajr ata karega, aur woh bahut ziyaada bakhshne waala aur meharbaani karne waala hai

Paighambar! Yeh ahl-e-kitaab aap se mutaalaba karte hain ke un par aasmaan se koi kitaab naazil kar dijiye. To unhon ne Moosa se is se ziyaada sangeen sawaal kiya tha jab un se yeh kaha ke humein Allah ko ala-l-e'laan dikhla dijiye, to un ke zulm ki bina par inhein ek bijli ne apni giraft mein le liya. Phir unhon ne hamaari nishaaniyon ke aa jaane ke ba-wujood gosaala bana liya, to hum ne us se bhi darguzar kiya aur Moosa ko khuli hui daleel ata kar di

Aur hum ne un ke ahd ki khilaaf-warzi ki bina par un ke saron par Koh-e-Toor ko buland kar diya, aur un se kaha ke darwaaze se sajda karte hue daakhil ho, aur un se kaha ke khabardaar Shamba ke mu'aamale mein ziyaadati na karna, aur un se bada sakht ahd le liya

Pas un ke ahd ko tod dene, aayaat-e-Khuda ke inkaar karne, aur ambiya ko naahaq qatl kar dene, aur yeh kehne ki bina par ke hamaare dilon par fitratan ghilaaf chadhe hue hain (hum ne un par la'nat ki), haalaanke aisa nahin hai balke Khuda ne un ke kufr ki bina par un ke dilon par mohr laga di hai, aur ab chand ek ke ilaawa koi imaan na laaega
Aur un ke kufr aur Maryam par azeem bohtaan lagaane ki bina par

Aur yeh kehne ki bina par ke hum ne Maseeh Eesa ibn-e-Maryam Rasoolullah ko qatl kar diya hai, haalaanke unhon ne na inhein qatl kiya hai aur na sooli di hai balke doosre ko un ki shabeeh bana diya gaya tha, aur jin logon ne Eesa ke baare mein ikhtilaaf kiya hai woh sab manzil-e-shak mein hain, aur kisi ko gumaan ki pairavi ke ilaawa koi ilm nahin hai, aur unhon ne yaqeenan inhein qatl nahin kiya hai
Balke Khuda ne apni taraf utha liya hai, aur Khuda saahib-e-ghalaba aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai
Aur koi ahl-e-kitaab mein aisa nahin hai jo apni maut se pehle un par imaan na laaye, aur qiyaamat ke din Eesa us ke gawaah honge
Pas un Yahoodiyon ke zulm ki bina par hum ne jin paakeeza cheezon ko halaal kar rakha tha un par haraam kar diya, aur un ke bahut se logon ko raah-e-Khuda se rokne ki bina par
Aur sood lene ki bina par jis se inhein roka gaya tha, aur naajaaiz tareeqe se logon ka maal khaane ki bina par, aur hum ne kaafiron ke liye bada dardnaak azaab muhayya kiya hai

Lekin un mein se jo log ilm mein rusookh rakhne waale aur imaan laane waale hain woh un sab par imaan rakhte hain jo tum par naazil hua hai ya tum se pehle naazil ho chuka hai, aur bil-khusoos namaaz qaaim karne waale aur zakaat dene waale aur aakhirat par imaan rakhne waale hain, hum anqareeb un sab ko ajr-e-azeem ata karenge

Hum ne aap ki taraf isi tarah wahi naazil ki hai jis tarah Nooh aur un ke baad ke ambiya ki taraf wahi ki thi, aur Ibraheem, Ismaaeel, Is'haaq, Ya'qoob, Asbaat, Eesa, Ayyoob, Yunus, Haaroon aur Sulaimaan ki taraf wahi ki hai, aur Daawood ko Zaboor ata ki hai
Kuch rasool hain jin ke qisse hum aap se bayaan kar chuke hain, aur kuch rasool hain jin ka tazkira hum ne nahin kiya hai, aur Allah ne Moosa se baa-qaa'ida guftagoo ki hai

Yeh saare rasool bashaarat dene waale aur daraane waale is liye bheje gaye taake rasoolon ke aane ke baad insaanon ki hujjat Khuda par qaaim na hone paaye, aur Khuda sab par ghaalib aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

(Yeh maanein ya na maanein) lekin Khuda ne jo kuch aap par naazil kiya hai woh khud us ki gawaahi deta hai ke us ne use apne ilm se naazil kiya hai, aur malaaika bhi gawaahi dete hain, aur Khuda khud bhi shahaadat ke liye kaafi hai
Beshak jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya aur raah-e-Khuda se mana' kar diya woh gumraahi mein bahut door tak chale gaye hain
Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar karne ke baad zulm kiya hai Khuda inhein hargiz maaf nahin kar sakta aur na inhein kisi raaste ki hidaayat kar sakta hai
Siwaaye Jahannam ke raaste ke jahaan un ko hamesha hamesha rehna hai, aur yeh Khuda ke liye bahut aasaan hai

Ae insaano! Tumhaare paas Parwardigar ki taraf se haq le kar Rasool aa gaya hai, lihaaza us par imaan le aao, isi mein tumhaari bhalaai hai. Aur agar tum ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya to yaad rakho ke zameen o aasmaan ki kul kaainaat Khuda ke liye hai, aur wahi ilm waala bhi hai aur hikmat waala bhi hai

Ae ahl-e-kitaab! Apne deen mein had se tajaawuz na karo aur Khuda ke baare mein haq ke ilaawa kuch na kaho. Maseeh Eesa ibn-e-Maryam sirf Allah ke rasool aur us ka kalima hain jise Maryam ki taraf ilqaa kiya gaya hai, aur woh us ki taraf se ek rooh hain. Lihaaza Khuda aur mursaleen par imaan le aao, aur khabardaar teen ka naam bhi na lo. Is se baaz aa jaao ke isi mein bhalaai hai. Allah faqat Khuda-e-Waahid hai aur woh is baat se munazzah hai ke us ka koi beta ho. Zameen o aasmaan mein jo kuch bhi hai sab usi ka hai, aur woh kafaalat o wakaalat ke liye kaafi hai

Na Maseeh ko is baat se inkaar hai ke woh banda-e-Khuda hain, aur na malaaika-e-muqarrabeen ko us ki bandagi se koi inkaar hai, aur jo bhi us ki bandagi se inkaar o istikbaar karega to Allah sab ko apni baargaah mein mahshoor karega

Phir jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye inhein mukammal ajr dega aur apne fazl o karam se izaafa bhi kar dega, aur jin logon ne inkaar aur takabbur se kaam liya hai un par dardnaak azaab karega, aur inhein Khuda ke ilaawa na koi sarparast milega aur na madadgaar
Ae insaano! Tumhaare paas tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se burhaan aa chuka hai, aur hum ne tumhaari taraf raushan noor bhi naazil kar diya hai
Pas jo log Allah par imaan laaye aur us se waabasta hue inhein woh apni rehmat aur apne fazl mein daakhil kar lega aur seedhe raaste ki hidaayat kar dega

Paighambar! Yeh log aap se fatwa daryaaft karte hain, to aap keh dijiye ke kalaala (bhaai behan) ke baare mein Khuda khud yeh hukm bayaan karta hai ke agar koi shakhs mar jaaye aur us ki aulaad na ho aur sirf behan waaris ho to use tarke ka nisf milega, aur isi tarah agar behan mar jaaye aur us ki aulaad na ho to bhaai us ka waaris hoga. Phir agar waaris do behnein hain to inhein tarke ka do tihaai milega, aur agar bhaai behan donon hain to mard ke liye aurat ka dohra hissa hoga. Khuda yeh sab waazeh kar raha hai taake tum behakne na paao, aur Khuda har shai ka khoob jaanne waala hai
